question: Estimate paint demand in a growing urban locality (Whitefield in Bengaluru — 50,000 households).
idealClarificationQuestions: Annual demand in volume + value? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: New construction + repaint cycle frequency × paint per household.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Whitefield households: 50,000 (high-rise apartments + villa enclaves + new construction zones).

benchmarkAssumptions.value: 50,000 (high-rise apartments + villa enclaves + new construction zones).

calculationFlow: Whitefield households: 50,000 (high-rise apartments + villa enclaves + new construction zones).
- New construction completion: ~5% per year = 2,500 new units/year.
- Full repaint (every 5-7 years): ~15% per year = 7,500 units.
- New construction (full painting): ~75-100 L per 2BHK = ~85L average.
